Hideaki Tezuka (Japanese: 手塚秀彰 Tezuka Hideaki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Tezuka was born on December 5, 1954, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided, among other roles in Japanese anime, the voice of Team Flare leader Lysandre during . In addition to voice acting roles, Tezuka is a prolific live-action actor and has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
